integrity: The statement is supported by a mathematical proof. Finite exhaustive word checks were replayed, but are not a substitute for the infinite proof. No external independent review or validation was performed.
limitations: Only fixed finite generating alphabets with their formal inverses; not a result about indexed-language membership, logarithmic space, or arbitrary inverse monoids. Tree-geodesic formulae are background; the contribution is the simultaneous explicit deterministic linear-workspace recognition of the three Green-representative languages. Literature search can miss unindexed earlier complexity bounds.
title: Deterministic linear-space recognition of the Green-geodesic languages of free inverse monoids
